get_lr_at_iter: get the learning rate at a given training iteration using the configured solver settings and warmup policy
lr_func_steps_with_lrs: compute the learning rate at a given iteration using explicit step boundaries and predefined LR values
lr_func_steps_with_decay: compute the learning rate at a given iteration using step boundaries with exponential gamma decay from base LR
lr_func_step: compute the learning rate at a given iteration using uniform step size with exponential gamma decay from base LR
get_step_index: find which learning rate step index a given iteration falls into based on configured step boundaries
